[[File:Annihilation teleport scroll detail.png|130px|left]]
The '''Annihilation teleport scroll''' is an item that can be purchased from the [[Deadman Reward Store]] for 10,000 [[Deadman: Apocalypse/Points|Deadman Points]], which are earned from participating in seasonal [[Deadman]] events. It can be used to unlock a [[Lever (Deserted Keep)|Wilderness lever]] themed [[Home Teleport]] [[animation override]]. To enable it, players can right click "Animation" on the Home Teleport spell icon in their spellbook and select "Annihilation."

[[File:Fire ruby detail.png|left|120px]]
The '''fire ruby''' is an [[elemental gems|elemental gem]] obtained by killing [[Infernal Mage|infernal mage]]s. It is used in the creation of the [[amulet of fire]]; the fire ruby must be used on the [[Fire Altar]] along with an [[amulet of magic]] and 100 [[fire rune]]s.

The player may bring a fire ruby or other elemental gems to [[Archmage Sedridor]] to get some hints on what to do with them.
